items.lede: The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos.
items.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos

items.lede: The fine is among the largest an Italian authority has imposed on a tech giant and Meta says it plans to appeal the decision Italy’s data protection agency has fined Facebook parent company Meta €805m ($887m) for accessing users’ photos without their specific consent.
